name: Nimb Brasserie
description: Tivoli's most prestigious dining destination, housed inside the stunning Moorish-inspired Nimb palace building dating from 1909. The Nimb Brasserie is one of Copenhagen's finest restaurants, serving exceptional French-Danish cuisine with seasonal ingredients in an atmosphere of unrivalled elegance. The palatial interior with its vaulted ceilings, rich fabrics and warm lighting creates an extraordinary setting for a meal, and the menu celebrates the finest produce Denmark has to offer. Booking well in advance is essential, particularly during summer.

name: Groften
description: One of Tivoli's oldest and most beloved restaurants, Groften has been serving traditional Danish food since 1874 in a charming pavilion setting with views over the park's beautiful lake. This is quintessential Tivoli dining — hearty Danish classics including frikadeller, smorrebrod and flaeskesteg served in a warm, relaxed atmosphere with live folk music in the evenings. A Tivoli institution that captures the soul of Danish food culture and the spirit of the gardens perfectly.

name: Wagamama
description: The beloved international Asian restaurant chain brings its signature ramen, noodle dishes and fresh flavours to the heart of Tivoli Gardens. Wagamama's open kitchen philosophy and communal bench seating offer a lively and casual dining experience. The menu's generous portions of katsu curry, teppanyaki and gyoza are consistently popular with families and solo diners alike.

name: Gasoline Grill
description: Copenhagen's legendary cult burger restaurant brings its award-winning smash burgers to Tivoli Gardens. Gasoline Grill has built a devoted following across Denmark for its perfectly crafted burgers made from premium Danish beef, fresh buns and quality toppings — consistently ranked among the best burgers in Scandinavia. A casual, delicious counter-service experience that delivers serious food credentials in the most magical of settings.
